params.name: npis
params.description: A comma-delimited list of Provider NPI numbers. A maximum of 50 items will be accepted at a time. One of `zip_code` or `npis` is required.

params.name: zip_code
params.description: A 5 digit zip code that will be used as the location to find facilities near by. One of `zip_code` or `npis` is required.

params.name: building_type
params.description: The type of facility building, which can be Clinic or Hospital.

params.name: page
params.description: The zero indexed page of results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

params.name: visit_reason_id
params.description: The Zocdoc ID of the visit reason to search by `zip_code` for. See [Reference Data](/guides/reference-data) for options.

params.name: insurance_plan_id
params.description: The Zocdoc ID of the patient's insurance plan to search by `zip_code` for. Use the [Get Insurance Plans](#operation/getInsurancePlans) endpoint to retrieve available plans.

params.name: max_distance_to_patient_mi
params.description: The maximum distance in miles from the facility to the search location (the center point of the given `zip_code`). Default is 50 miles.

items.docs: Get a set of facilities within the developer's network.
